text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to the cafeteria, Sakura Laurel had
a mountain of food spread out across the table.
A savory aroma wafted through the air.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much♪
Actually, I made it myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Dad sent some rare seasonings from France.
So I decided to try my hand at making French cuisine with them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Well, I followed a recipe from an authentic restaurant,
and it ended up making a bit too much.
So I packed it into a bento and brought it along.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, I'm gonna eat every last bite!
I want to tell Father how delicious it was!
choice_data_list: I think that's way too much for one person to eat.
Gotta eat well and give a taste report!
I gotta eat well and give a taste report, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, I'm gonna eat every last bite!
I want to tell Father how delicious it was!
choice_data_list: I think that's way too much for one person to eat.
Gotta eat well and give a taste report!
I gotta eat well and give a taste report, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... True.
When you're completely full, even delicious food
doesn't taste as good anymore, does it...?
choice_data_list: If you'd like, want me to help you eat it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Really? That's a huge help!
Well, don't mind if I do—I'm gonna sample
every single flavor♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's eat together!
Bon appétit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sharing the meal between them, Sakura Laurel made sure
to eat only a moderate portion.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If it's for Dad, I wonder if he'd prefer
it stuffed with cream cheese?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Laurel ate French cuisine while thinking of her father. And went on to finish the massive spread entirely.
